skill.name: writing-beats
skill.description: Guides an assistant to turn fixed raw material into a long-form article by writing one grounded beat at a time.
skill.summary: Builds articles through user-selected writing beats with explicit concept grounding.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: The static finding is a false positive. The referenced instruction asks where to save an article file and does not request system reconnaissance, secret access, or hidden path discovery.

static_findings.snippet: If the user did not say where to save the article, ask once and remember the path.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 11 asks the assistant to ask the user for an article save path when none is provided. This is normal workflow state, not system reconnaissance or unauthorized filesystem discovery.

content.value_statement: Long-form drafts often lose readers when ideas arrive out of order. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code build an article through grounded, user-selected beats.
actual_capabilities: Turns fixed raw material into candidate article beats.
Tracks which concepts are already grounded for the audience.
Offers two or three possible next beats at each step.
Appends only the selected beat to the article file.
Re-reads the article file before each new write.
Supports rewriting or changing earlier beats when requested.
limitations: Requires raw source material from the user.
Does not independently research missing facts.
Needs a target file path before writing the article.
May leave unused material when the article reaches a natural end.

use_cases.title: Draft a technical article
use_cases.description: Convert notes into a structured article that introduces concepts before using them.

use_cases.title: Shape a founder essay
use_cases.description: Explore different openings and choose the path that best develops the argument.

use_cases.title: Refine an educational walkthrough
use_cases.description: Build a lesson one beat at a time while tracking what the reader already understands.

prompt_templates.title: Start from raw notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin a guided article draft from one markdown file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this raw material to draft an article beat by beat. Ask me for prerequisites and a save path before writing.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an opening
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare possible entry points before committing to the article.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three candidate starting beats from my notes. Explain what each beat requires and what each beat grounds.

prompt_templates.title: Continue the journey
prompt_templates.scenario: Add the next section after a selected beat exists.
prompt_templates.prompt: Re-read the article file, then offer three reachable next beats. Show what each option unlocks before I choose.

prompt_templates.title: Revise an earlier beat
prompt_templates.scenario: Change direction after the article has already started.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite beat 3 in place using a calmer angle. Then update the grounded concepts and suggest the next reachable beats.

output_examples.input: Raw notes about a product launch and a beginner audience.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes several opening beats, names the concepts each one introduces, and waits for the user's selection.

output_examples.input: An existing article file with two completed beats.
output_examples.output: The skill re-reads the file, preserves existing edits, and offers reachable next beats based on grounded concepts.

output_examples.input: A request to replace beat 3 with a different angle.
output_examples.output: The skill edits that beat in place, keeps unrelated text stable, and recalculates what future beats can use.

best_practices: Provide raw material as a markdown file with clear source notes.
Define the target audience before choosing the first beat.
Review each candidate beat for reader knowledge before writing.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent facts outside the supplied material.
Do not skip prerequisite discussion for a technical audience.
Do not request a full article draft in one pass.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It helps create long-form articles from raw material, one selected writing beat at a time.

faq.question: Does it write the whole article at once?
faq.answer: No. It appends one chosen beat, then offers next beat options after re-reading the file.

faq.question: What is a grounded concept?
faq.answer: A grounded concept is an idea the audience already knows or has met in an earlier beat.

faq.question: Can it use Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it perform research?
faq.answer: No. It works from the raw material the user provides and does not fetch external sources.

faq.question: Can it revise earlier beats?
faq.answer: Yes. It can rewrite a selected beat in place and adjust future beat options.
